available_variables.label: VIIRS Presumed Vegetation Fire Density (type 0)
available_variables.plain_definition: Number of satellite-detected vegetation fire hotspots (nominal/high confidence) per 1,000 square kilometers per satellite-observed day; counts pixel hotspots across overpasses, not distinct fires or burned area.

supported_baselines.unsupported_reason: VIIRS S-NPP Archive Export in this repository starts in 2019-03; 2015-2018 data is absent so 2015-2019 baseline must stay disabled.

spatial_support.resolution: 375 m VIIRS S-NPP pixels summarized over study boxes and 0.25 deg grid cells
spatial_support.sampling_method: Type-0 detection count divided by (box_area_km2 / 1000) and CMR VNP14IMG observed satellite days

sources: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP Archive Export (SV-C2)
limitations: 2015-2019 baseline is strictly unsupported/disabled because this archive begins in 2019-03 (only 2019-2021 pre-war baseline is valid).
Hotspot pixel counts are not burned area in km^2: repeated overpasses and multi-pixel fire fronts cluster detections (~1.42 det/cell-day).
2022 contains a 16-day satellite observation gap (notably 2022-07-27 through 2022-08-10 orbit outage, plus 2022-03-05).
Matched-date (169d/yr) UKR-ADM0 polygon clipping shifts absolute ratios (~63.9% vs 104.3% in Donbas) and is kept strictly separate.

available_variables.label: VIIRS Other Static Land Source Density (type 2)
available_variables.plain_definition: Number of persistent stationary heat detections (steelworks, industrial plants, and gas flares) per 1,000 square kilometers per satellite-observed day.

supported_baselines.unsupported_reason: VIIRS S-NPP Archive Export in this repository starts in 2019-03; 2015-2018 data is absent so 2015-2019 baseline must stay disabled.

spatial_support.resolution: 375 m VIIRS S-NPP pixels summarized over study boxes and 0.25 deg grid cells
spatial_support.sampling_method: Type-2 static land source count divided by (box_area_km2 / 1000) and CMR VNP14IMG observed satellite days

sources: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP Archive Export (SV-C2)
limitations: 2015-2019 baseline is strictly unsupported/disabled (archive begins 2019-03).
Tracks stationary industrial/metallurgical/gas-flare hotspots; sharp 2022 drops in frontline corridors (e.g. -83% in Donbas-Kharkiv) reflect facility shutdowns/destruction rather than fire absence.
Boxes with zero baseline type-2 detections (e.g. Kyiv 0.5 deg box) withhold % change.

available_variables.label: 2m Air Temperature
available_variables.plain_definition: Monthly average air temperature 2 meters above the ground, describing regional baseline warmth across seasons.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

uncertainty_and_status.pct_change_withheld_reason: Interval-scale or signed quantity crossing zero; report abs_diff instead of % change.

limitations: Interval-scale °C unit: absolute difference is reported while relative % change is strictly withheld (null).
Regional fire-weather context only (0.5 deg box average), not local flame temperature.

available_variables.label: Monthly Peak 2m Air Temperature (T2M_MAX)
available_variables.plain_definition: Monthly extreme maximum air temperature at 2 meters height (single hottest reading of the month, not the mean of daily highs), capturing heat extremes that dry surface fuels.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of monthly extreme maximum 2m air temperature (T2M_MAX)

uncertainty_and_status.pct_change_withheld_reason: Interval-scale or signed quantity crossing zero; report abs_diff instead of % change.

limitations: Interval-scale °C unit: relative % change is strictly withheld (null).
Coarse 0.5 deg box average cannot capture fine-scale heat domes.

available_variables.label: Diurnal Temperature Range (T2M_RANGE)
available_variables.plain_definition: Monthly average of the daily spread between daytime high and nighttime low temperatures, which widens during sunny dry spells and shrinks under clouds.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.625 deg MERRA-2 sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of daily Tmax - Tmin magnitude

limitations: Regional synoptic dryness/clear-sky context indicator; coarse 0.5 deg resolution.

available_variables.label: All-Sky Downward Shortwave Sunlight
available_variables.plain_definition: Actual average solar energy reaching the ground after cloud shading, driving surface heating and water evaporation.

spatial_support.resolution: 1.0 deg CERES sampled over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Cos(lat)-weighted mean of 3x3 box-spanning NASA POWER grid points

limitations: Coarse 1.0 deg surface insolation context used in radiation/PET fire-weather checks.

available_variables.label: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith Potential Evapotranspiration (PET)
available_variables.plain_definition: Standardized FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evaporation demand from a hypothetical well-watered reference grass surface given local sun, heat, humidity, and wind.

spatial_support.resolution: 0.5 deg MERRA-2 / 1.0 deg CERES derived over 3x3 cos(lat) lattice
spatial_support.sampling_method: Monthly FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference ET using regional box elevation; strict daily PM sensitivity checked (RMSE 0.119 mm/day)

limitations: Measures atmospheric evaporative demand over coarse regional boxes, not actual irrigation or localized drought stress.

supported_baselines.unsupported_reason: VIIRS S-NPP Archive Export in this repository starts in 2019-03; 2015-2018 data is absent so 2015-2019 baseline must stay disabled.

normalization.primary_label: VIIRS presumed vegetation detections (type 0) per 1,000 km^2 of box area per CMR-observed satellite day

separately_reported_methods.description: 169 common matched calendar dates/year clipped to UKR-ADM0 polygon land area; stored under matched_dates_169d_ukr_adm0_sensitivity.
Unnormalized detections per observed day; stored under legacy_unnormalized_rate.

quality_flags.unsupported_baseline_reason: VIIRS SV-C2 export begins 2019-03; 2015-2019 comparison is disabled/withheld.

repeated_overpass_clustering.definition: Cells rounded to 0.01 deg (~1.1 km N-S x ~0.72 km E-W at 49N). Multiple rows in one cell/day occur from multi-pixel fire fronts, swath overlap, or twice-daily D/N S-NPP overpasses.

quality_flags.static_source_caveat: Type-2 detections track industrial/gas-flare sources; frontline drops reflect shutdown/damage rather than reduced fire risk.

limitations: Hotspot counts measure 375 m pixel-center thermal anomalies per overpass, NOT number of fires, forest loss area, or burned hectares.
Repeated detections (~30-38% of 0.01-deg cells have multiple detections) amplify slow-moving or persistent sources across swath overlaps and day/night overpasses.
FIRMS type=2 static industrial detections (steelworks/flares, e.g., Mariupol & Kryvyi Rih) plunged -77.5% in 2022; including type=2 mixes industrial shutdowns with open fires.
Suomi NPP suffered a 15-day outage (2022-07-27 to 2022-08-10; plus zero detections on 2022-03-05), reducing August 2022 to 21/31 observed days.

Proposed study/reference boxes inside Ukraine are candidates for team agreement and are NOT validated causal controls; pre-2022 fire regimes differ sharply between Western/Northern spring burning and Eastern/Southern summer steppe burning.
No meteorological controls (drought, soil moisture, temperature, cloud obstruction) or causal attribution models are included.
